answer: The orchard schedule is applied in horizon and trellis shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4250 identities would post 1108 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
